newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Deson Dev ends debut with modest gain.
newsitem.headline: Deson Dev ends debut with modest gain.

text.p: Shares of Deson Development International Holdings Ltd finished their trading debut on Tuesday at HK$1.37 per share, or 37 percent above their issue price of HK$1.00.
The stock moved within a range of HK$1.20 and HK$1.63 on volume of 55.49 million shares worth HK$82.46 million.
"Trading in the counter was relatively quiet but it managed to close at a premium to the issue price," said Franco Tong, institution sales manager at New China Hong Kong.
Deson, a construction and property firm, offered 75 million new shares in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The grey market price of Deson shares was about HK$1.55 on Friday. "The stock was traded below the market's expectation," said Edwin Cheung, dealing director at Taiwan Securities.
"The momentum of the overall market was weak today and this also affect Deson's performance," Cheung said.
The blue chip Hang Seng Index dropped 215.42 points, or 1.47 percent, to close at 14,439.71 on Tuesday.
But brokers said Deson has a good connection in China and should trade at a premium to other construction firms.

The Hong Kong-based Deson planned to use the money raised from the new issue to fund its investment in the Chinese government-sponsored Economic Housing Scheme and to expand its construction business.
Brokers also said the agreement by Okabe Co Ltd of Japan to take a strategic stake in Deson was likely to give the company good support.
Okabe, a scaffolding and structural materials maker in Japan, had agreed to buy 9.4 percent of Deson at issue price.
